component.name: Alaturka Vakitler
component.summary: Alaturka clock, prayer times and the hijri calendar
Alaturka saat, namaz vakitleri ve hicri takvim

description.p: The alaturka clock counts from the evening adhan rather than from midnight, the way time was kept in Ottoman daily life. This app shows it next to the ordinary clock, together with the day's six prayer times and a countdown to the next one.
Alaturka saat gece yarısından değil akşam ezanından itibaren sayar. Bu uygulama onu vasati saatin yanında, günün altı vakti ve sonraki vakte kalan süreyle birlikte gösterir.

ul.li: A month calendar in either reckoning, Gregorian or hijri
The religious days — kandils, the two bayrams, arefe and Aşure
All 81 Turkish provinces, with an offline cache

description.p: Prayer times come from the Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı. The hijri conversion follows Diyanet's own table of month beginnings rather than an arithmetic calendar, which drifts from it by up to two days.
